name: 默认的许青
description: The figure is a lean, short twenty-six-year-old. The face is narrow with long narrow eyes, and ear-length hair, trimmed at home, ends ragged and straw-yellow. The skin is tanned dark, and an old pale scar crosses the left brow ridge. The outfit is a dark green work jacket with cuffs worn through at both wrists, a white crew-neck shirt showing at the neckline beneath it, dark blue jeans rolled twice at the hem, and black canvas sneakers splitting open at the toe. The jacket sits slightly loose across the shoulders, and the white shirt adds a narrow band of white down the open jacket front. The sneakers are low canvas with laces and pale flat soles. Horizontal 16:9 turnaround sheet on pure white. The left third holds a front-facing half-body portrait, both shoulders visible, straight bottom edge. The upper right holds three full-body views: front, a standard ninety-degree side, and a full back. The lower right holds three detail cells. The three views share one standing pose, feet planted slightly apart. The portrait fixes the long narrow eyes, the thin pale scar above the left brow and the ragged straw-yellow ends as reference marks. The side view shows the jacket's straight side seam and the rolled jean hem resting on the sneaker heel. In the back view the jacket shows only its plain back panel, shoulder seams and straight hem, with the rolled jean hems sitting above the sneakers. The first detail cell crops the hairline and ragged ends from the front view. The second crops the frayed cuff and wrist from the left portrait. The third crops the split toe of the sneaker from the side view. Soft directional light models the face in the portrait; flat even light covers the three views and the detail cells. Colors, fabrics, the scar on the left brow and the frayed cuffs stay identical across the portrait, the three views and the detail cells.

name: 穿白衬衫的许青
description: The figure is a lean, short twenty-six-year-old. The face is narrow with long narrow eyes, and ear-length hair, trimmed at home, ends ragged and straw-yellow. The skin is tanned dark, and an old pale scar crosses the left brow ridge. The outfit is a crisp white shirt with a stiff collar, tucked into black dress trousers that carry a pressed crease down each leg, with polished leather shoes below. The hair is wetted down and smoothed flat against the head, hiding the ragged ends, and the collar stands closed and stiff at the throat. The shirt front stays plain across the chest, its hem disappearing into the waistband. Horizontal 16:9 turnaround sheet on pure white. The left third holds a front-facing half-body portrait, both shoulders visible, straight bottom edge. The upper right holds three full-body views: front, a standard ninety-degree side, and a full back. The lower right holds three detail cells. The three views share one standing pose, feet planted slightly apart. The portrait fixes the long narrow eyes, the scar above the left brow and the flat smoothed hair as reference marks. The side view shows the tucked waistband and the shirt's plain side seam falling straight to the hip. In the back view the shirt shows a plain back yoke above the waistband, and the trousers carry a straight hem over the shoes. The first detail cell crops the stiff collar and throat from the front view. The second crops the flattened hair and left temple from the left portrait. The third crops the polished shoe and its low heel from the side view. Colors, fabrics and the scar on the left brow stay identical across the portrait, the three views and the detail cells. Soft directional light models the face in the portrait; flat even light covers the three views and the detail cells. Reuses base look: 许青. State: after the rain the white shirt is soaked through and clings to the body, a red soaked patch spreading across the right shoulder where the skin was scraped open against a door frame, the smoothed hair beginning to drop loose.

name: 老赵
description: The person is a heavy-set man in his early forties with a thick neck. The face is fleshy with heavy coarse cheeks, the eyes narrow to slits, and the head is bald. A dark oil-slicked leather jacket hangs open over a floral-print shirt with its top three buttons undone, and a thick gold chain sits at the throat. The jacket is bulky across the shoulders, its front panels hang open past the waist, and the leather keeps a greasy shine along the collar and cuffs. Horizontal 16:9 turnaround sheet on pure white. The left third holds a front-facing half-body portrait, both shoulders visible, straight bottom edge. The upper right holds three full-body views: front, a standard ninety-degree side, and a full back. The lower right holds three detail cells. The three views share one standing pose, feet planted slightly apart. The portrait fixes the bald crown, the squinting narrow eyes and the exposed gold chain as reference marks. In the back view the bare scalp runs down to the nape above the jacket's plain back panel and shoulder seams. Rain has soaked the jacket, which now shows a wet sheen across the shoulders, and the gold chain lies outside the collar. The first detail cell crops the bald crown and hairline from the front view. The second crops the open collar and gold chain from the left portrait. The third crops the wet jacket shoulder seam from the back view. Soft directional light models the face in the portrait; flat even light covers the three views and the detail cells. The build, the bald head, the fleshy features, the leather jacket and the gold chain stay identical across the portrait, the three views and the detail cells.
